If your tracking number shows no movement, it’s usually normal at first. Carriers often don’t scan packages until they reach their first sorting facility, which can take 5–7 business days after the label is created. During that time, the package may still be moving even though the tracking page hasn’t updated yet.

Keep checking the tracking link for updates.
Allow a few business days for the carrier’s first scan.
If there’s still no movement after about 7–10 business days, it may indicate a processing delay and further review may be needed.
